subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: are you brothers the mistress in the house said turning to the dervishes no by allah they said we are poor wanderers who met by mere chance we pray for allahs pardon Part—B: Writing (Marks—40)
guide_solution: Punctuation and capitalization: "Are you brothers?" the mistres the mistress in the house said, turning to the dervishes. "No, by Allah," they said, "We are poor wanderers who met by mere chance. We pray for Allah's pardon." ●Note: For writing part solution, see the folder name ‘Writing Part’ in Google drive.
